new.s: The name 'Vijayanagara', the capital built by Harihara and Bukka on the south bank of the Tungabhadra, means:
new.x: Vijayanagara means 'City of Victory'; it was built on the south bank of the Tungabhadra and its ruins lie at Hampi. 'City of Learning', 'City of Gold' and 'City of the Boar' are not meanings of the name (the boar, Varaha, was the royal emblem, not the city's name).

new.s: The title 'Vedamarga Pratishthapaka' was borne by which Sangama ruler?
new.x: Bukka I (1356-77) bore the title Vedamarga Pratishthapaka. Harihara I's title was Purva-Paschima Samudradhipati; Harihara II was called Rajavyasa and Rajavalmiki; Devaraya II was Gajabetekara.
new.tq: Bukka - Vedas (Sayana-Madhava commentaries began under him) - Vedamarga.

new.s: Abdur Razzaq, who visited Vijayanagara in 1443 during the reign of Devaraya II, came as the envoy of:
new.x: Abdur Razzaq was the Persian envoy of Shah Rukh and visited in 1443 under Devaraya II. Firuz Shah Bahmani fought Devaraya I; the Ming emperor received Bukka I's embassy (1374); the Portuguese came later, under the Tuluvas.

new.s: According to the political maxims in Krishnadevaraya's Amuktamalyada, the command of forts should be entrusted to:
new.x: Amuktamalyada advises that Brahmins should command forts. It does not recommend foreign mercenaries, forest chiefs (whom it advises winning over, not arming as fort commanders) or Muslim cavalry officers for this post.
new.tq: Amuktamalyada: revenue to army, Brahmins in forts, win over forest tribes.

new.x: The main seat of Vasavi Kanyaka Parameswari is Penugonda in West Godavari (APPSC G2 2019 key). Penukonda was a later Vijayanagara capital, Srikalahasti a Shaiva centre and Ahobilam a Narasimha (Vaishnava) centre.

new.s: Which inscription lays down twelve rules (Dwadasa Sutras) for the construction of a tank?
new.x: The Porumamilla inscription (Kadapa), issued by Bhaskara Mantri and recording the Anantasagaram tank (1369, Bukka I's time), gives the 12 rules for building a tank (APPSC G2 2012, 2019). Tummalagudem, Bitragunta and Palampet are the usual trap distractors and are not linked with these rules.
new.tq: Porumamilla = tank rules (Dwadasa Sutras), Bhaskara Mantri.
